observed_failures_and_corrections: Initial discovery treated the absent NPC starter relation as suspicious. Native ItemSparse and the actual SendNewItem path established the intentional item-started route before any implementation change was proposed.
One exploratory SQL query assumed an InhabitType creature_template column absent from this schema; the query failed without mutation. No movement/flight repair was inferred from it.

The first new harness compile lacked the standard array header; added the explicit include. The first execution then admitted loot before the new strict three-item fixture store was populated, so native IsValid correctly rejected it. Moved verified item metadata initialization ahead of native loader admission; did not weaken IsValid or alter production data.

A private next-quest inventory probe initially assumed the old archive QuestSortID column position and returned no rows. Switched it to the parsed schema field index; this did not affect the independently checked quest IDs/objectives or World data.
